body.intent: Fix Every run whose change edits CLI help, settings or the workflow format now fails at review/code. The code check runs rhiza check in-process (internal/api/run_codecheck.go:132 runCheck) with the installed binary, and since #412 (generated reference) check compares docs/reference/ with what that binary's rhiza docs writes, not the branch's build. Run 01M6ZRM3QDK5VYBER6DYZDDR65 (change set 01M6ZQ588DTH): 'rhiza check: fail render docs/reference/cli.md: differs from what rhiza docs writes'. In its worktree the branch build's check passes ('3 unchanged' from its rhiza docs) while ~/bin/rhiza check fails the same way. Retry can never pass until the change is merged and installed. Fix: the code check judges docs/reference with the run worktree's own build (as make self-check does), or leaves that one check to make self-check/CI.
